Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Janesville for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 through January 2, 2027 (Holiday Light Show at Rotary Botanical Gardens), with Lighted Christmas Parade in Downtown Monroe (December 4), Holiday Tree Show at the Lincoln-Tallman House (December 4 to December 27) and Janesville's Jolly Jingle (December 4 to December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
